services.question: What does the Medical Concierge Agency actually do?
services.answer: We support international patients through the full journey: clinic and specialist selection, treatment coordination, document handling, communication, and travel organization.

clinicSelection.question: Can you help us choose the right clinic or specialist in Germany?
clinicSelection.answer: Yes. We look at your request, medical context, and practical circumstances to suggest relevant clinics and suitable specialists.

travel.question: Do I need to already be in Germany to contact you?
travel.answer: No. Many patients begin remotely. We help prepare the process in advance and structure the medical journey before arrival in Germany.

documents.question: Do you help with records, translation, and communication with clinics?
documents.answer: Yes. We help organize medical documents, translate materials, and create clear communication between everyone involved in the process.

onSite.question: Do you also support travel and on-site coordination?
onSite.answer: Yes. When needed, we can support transfers, logistics, local coordination, and in-person stages so the patient and family feel more at ease.

start.question: How do we get started?
start.answer: You can begin by submitting a request through the website. We then get in touch, understand your situation, and outline the most relevant next step.

privacyPolicy.title: Privacy Policy
privacyPolicy.intro1: We take the protection of our users' data very seriously and are committed to safeguarding the information you provide when using our website and services.
privacyPolicy.intro2: This Privacy Policy explains how we collect, use, and protect your data.
privacyPolicy.intro3: Please read this policy carefully. If you do not agree with our data practices, please refrain from using our website.
privacyPolicy.intro4: Detailed information regarding data protection can be found below.

dataCollection.title: Data Collection
dataCollection.text: We may collect the following types of data:
dataCollection.item1: Anonymized technical data (non-personal data). This includes general usage information that cannot be used to identify you.
dataCollection.item2: Personal data. Information that you explicitly provide to us, such as your name, contact details, and medical records.
dataCollection.text2: The website operator acts as the data controller. Our contact details are listed below.

howWeCollect.title: How We Collect Your Data
howWeCollect.text1: Your data is primarily collected when you provide it to us via contact forms, questionnaires, or when sending medical documents.
howWeCollect.text2: Please note that data transmission over the Internet (e.g., via email) may have security vulnerabilities. We recommend exercising caution when sharing sensitive medical documents.

purpose.title: Purpose of Data Processing
purpose.text: We use your data for the following purposes:
purpose.item1: To ensure the proper functioning of our website;
purpose.item2: To respond to your inquiries and organize your medical treatment;
purpose.item3: To improve the quality of our services;
purpose.item4: For internal analytics and statistical purposes;
purpose.item5: To send you important service updates.
purpose.text2: We process your personal data only if:
purpose.legal1: It is necessary for the performance of a contract (e.g., organizing your trip);
purpose.legal2: It is required to comply with legal obligations;
purpose.legal3: It is necessary for our legitimate business interests.

sharing.title: Who We Share Your Data With
sharing.text1: We may share technical data with our trusted IT service providers (e.g., hosting and analytics).
sharing.text2: Medical documents and personal data are shared exclusively with third parties directly involved in your treatment, such as clinics, physicians, and medical interpreters.
sharing.text3: We will only disclose your information to external parties if required by law or to protect public safety.

rights.title: Your Rights
rights.text: You have the right to request information about the personal data we store about you at any time. You can also request the correction or complete deletion of this data. To exercise these rights, please contact us.

hosting.title: Hosting
hosting.text1: Our website and databases are hosted on reliable cloud servers.
hosting.text2: These servers are located globally, including within the European Union.
hosting.text3: Our hosting providers process data securely and strictly follow our instructions.

cookies.title: Cookies
cookies.text1: We use cookies to analyze website performance and enhance your user experience.
cookies.text2: We will not share your contact details with advertising networks without your explicit consent.

storage.title: Data Storage
storage.text1: We work with trusted partners worldwide to ensure the delivery of our services.
storage.text2: Your medical information is processed in compliance with strict confidentiality and privacy standards.

retention.title: Retention Period
retention.text: Your personal data will be stored only for as long as necessary to fulfill the purpose for which it was collected, or until you request its deletion. To request deletion, please email us at contact@gmed-health.com.

security.title: Security
security.text1: We implement modern security measures to protect your data on our servers.
security.text2: However, no system connected to the Internet is completely secure.
security.text3: We ask that you use secure passwords and remain cautious when sending confidential information.
security.text4: Using instant messaging apps to send documents is done at your own risk.

minors.title: Children's Privacy
minors.text1: We organize treatment for patients of all ages, including minors.
minors.text2: Data concerning minors is collected only with the explicit consent of their parents or legal guardians.
minors.text3: Parents can review and request the deletion of their child's data at any time.
minors.text4: Please contact us if you have any questions regarding your child's data profile.

updates.title: Changes to This Policy
updates.text: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The most current version will always be available on this page.
